title: Hypersleep
description: One Player can skip the night. Support Minecraft version 1.21x
body:
# 🌙 One Player Sleep

## Overview
A lightweight and elegant datapack that allows a single player to skip the night by sleeping, eliminating the need for all players to sleep simultaneously. Perfect for multiplayer servers and solo gameplay!

## ✨ Features
- **Single Player Sleep** - Only one player needs to sleep to skip the night
- **⚡ Time Acceleration** - Time flows 2000x faster while sleeping (not instant teleport)
- **🌾 Full Game Mechanics** - Crops grow, furnaces smelt, mobs spawn - everything continues naturally
- **📅 Day Counter Preserved** - World day counter increments normally, no resets
- **💬 No Spam** - Clean implementation without repetitive chat messages
- **🎮 Universal Compatibility** - Works perfectly in Survival, Hardcore, and all game modes
- **🔧 Easy Uninstall** - Includes uninstall function for clean removal

## 📦 Installation
1. Download the datapack
2. Navigate to your world's datapacks folder:
   ```
   .minecraft/saves/[Your World Name]/datapacks/
   ```
3. Place the `one_player_sleep` folder inside
4. In-game, run `/reload` or restart your world
5. You'll see a green confirmation message when successfully loaded

## 🎮 How It Works
When any player enters a bed during nighttime:
- Time accelerates by 100 ticks per game tick (2000x speed)
- All game mechanics continue to process normally
- Crops grow, furnaces work, and day/night cycle progresses naturally
- When morning arrives, time returns to normal speed
- No instant skip, no day counter reset, no spam

## 🗑️ Uninstallation
1. In-game, run: `/function one_player_sleep:uninstall`
2. Delete the `one_player_sleep` folder from your datapacks directory
3. Run `/reload`

## 🛠️ Technical Details
- **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11 (Mounts of Mayhem)
- **Pack Format:** 48 - 94
- **Dependencies:** None
- **Performance Impact:** Minimal (runs only during sleep)

## 📋 Compatibility
- ✅ Single Player
- ✅ Multiplayer Servers
- ✅ Realms
- ✅ Hardcore Mode
- ✅ All Dimensions (Overworld sleep mechanics)
- ✅ Other Datapacks (non-conflicting)

## 🐛 Known Issues
None currently reported!

## 📝 Changelog
### Version 1.0.0
- Initial release
- Time acceleration mechanic
- Single player sleep functionality
- Uninstall function

## 💡 Why Choose This Datapack?
Unlike other one-player sleep datapacks that instantly skip to day, this one accelerates time naturally. This means:
- Your farms actually grow while you sleep
- Furnaces and other machines continue working
- The game world feels more realistic
- No jarring instant transitions

## 🤝 Support
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please report them on the issue tracker!

## 📜 License
Free to use and modify for personal and server use.

---

**Enjoy peaceful nights in Minecraft! 🌙✨**

# 🎯 REMINDER

## 🌙 One Player Sleep - Natural Time Acceleration

**Tired of waiting for everyone to sleep?** This datapack lets a single player skip the night while keeping the game realistic!

### 🌟 What Makes This Special?

Unlike other datapacks that **instantly teleport** time to day, One Player Sleep **accelerates time naturally** at 2000x speed. This means:

✅ **Crops actually grow** while you sleep  
✅ **Furnaces smelt items** naturally  
✅ **Day counter increases** properly  
✅ **Zero chat spam** - clean and elegant  
✅ **No instant skips** - smooth time flow  

### ⚡ Perfect For:
- Multiplayer servers where not everyone is online
- Solo players who want vanilla-like sleep mechanics
- Hardcore worlds where every second counts
- Builders who want their farms to work overnight

### 🎮 How It Works:
1. **Any player** gets in bed during night
2. Time flows **2000x faster** until morning
3. All game mechanics continue **naturally**
4. Wake up with grown crops and smelted items!

### 📦 Installation:
Drop into your `datapacks` folder → `/reload` → Done!

### 🗑️ Easy Removal:
Run `/function one_player_sleep:uninstall` → Delete folder → `/reload`

---

**Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.11 | Works in all game modes | No dependencies required**

*Experience sleep the way it should be - natural, fast, and hassle-free!* 🌙✨
